title: 你的 AI 团队由专家组成
author: Every Staff
content:
Hello, and happy Sunday. Our Builder Pack for All Access members includes two new tools: Paper Pro, a design canvas that turns your work into code, and Mobbin Team, a library of more than 600,000 screens from shipped products. Both plug into Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor, and bring the Builder Pack to more than $9,000 in value. Last Friday we ran our first office hours for All Access subscribers, where we showed how we use the pack inside Every and worked through member projects live. This week paid subscribers also unlocked 14 voice-to-text workflows from the Every team, a Codex-to-Codex handoff, and a skill audit from Kieran Klaassen.—Kate Lee

Was this newsletter forwarded to you? Sign up to get it in your inbox.

Knowledge base

“Inside OpenAI’s Race to Reinvent Software Development for the Agent Era” by Laura Entis: Laura spoke with six members of OpenAI’s infrastructure team—including its vice president of applied infrastructure engineering—about three converging pressures: an overwhelming surge of AI-generated code, software-development infrastructure pushed toward its limits, and a fundamental redesign of how code gets reviewed and kept reliable. Read this to see what every software organization is about to face before it does.

🔏 “Build Faster With Voice” by Naveen Naidu and Laura Entis/Guides: Our definitive guide to working by voice. Paired with an agent, speech removes the translation step, so you can act on a customer call or a half-formed idea without writing it up first. Monologue general manager Naveen Naidu walks through the five-step loop every voice workflow follows. Paid subscribers get a library of 14 workflows from the Every team—including head of growth Austin Tedesco turning an all-hands into a recap, Kieran polishing an app and storing voice notes as living memory, and Daniel Rodrigues building custom design tools out loud.

🔏 “Fable as CEO” by Laura Entis/Context Window: Our engineers have started describing Anthropic’s models as a company org chart—Fable as CEO, Opus 5 a senior engineer, Sonnet 5 a junior—as labs shift from expensive generalist models to a “mixture-of-models” structure where specialized models collaborate inside one harness, per head of platform Willie Williams. Also inside: the rise of “Claudish,” “the daily driver,” the running list of models the team is using this week; and a “steal this workflow” on how head of operations Arielle Shipper and Austin had their Codex agents hand off work to each other.

🔏 “Taming Opus 5” by Katie Parrott/Context Window: After the Opus 5 Vibe Check, the rest of the Every team spent the weekend with the model—its unruliness held up, but they found a way to tame it. Also inside: a “steal this workflow” on how Flora turns one reference image into a reusable creative system; a second workflow, “Is it the skill or the model?,” for auditing whether instructions built for an older model are hurting the new one; and why one-shot AI video-game demos flood social feeds.
aiSummary: 本通讯整理了 Every 关于 AI 辅助软件开发的最新文章，涵盖 OpenAI 为代理时代进行的基础设施大改造、语音转文本工作流程，以及专家模型像组织架构一样协作的"混合模型"新范式。
oneSentenceSummary: 本通讯整理了 Every 关于 AI 辅助软件开发的最新文章，涵盖 OpenAI 为代理时代进行的基础设施大改造、语音转文本工作流程，以及专家模型像组织架构一样协作的"混合模型"新范式。
summary: 这是 Every 为付费订阅用户发布的周刊，整理了四篇最新文章。首篇文章介绍了 OpenAI 基础设施团队六名成员，他们讨论了三个趋同的挑战：激增的 AI 生成代码、基础设施的极限被推动以及代码评审的根本性重构。第二篇是关于语音转文本工作流的指南，认为将语音与代理结合可以消除思维到行动的转换步骤，并包含 14 个实际团队工作流程示例。第三篇引入了"混合模型"框架，每日工程师将 Anthropic 的模型阵列比作组织架构：Fable 担任 CEO，Opus 5 担任高级工程师，Sonnet 5 担任初级工程师，反映了从昂贵的通用型模型向专用模型在统一框架内协作的转变。最后一篇文章涵盖了团队周末驯服 Opus 5 的实验、审计旧指令是否损害新模型性能的工作流程，以及 AI 视频游戏演示为何在社交媒体上广泛传播。通讯还推广了面向全访问会员的 Builder Pack。

mainPoints.point: OpenAI 正在为代理驱动的时代重新设计软件基础设施
mainPoints.explanation: 六名基础设施团队成员描述了三个趋同的压力：激增的 AI 生成代码、基础设施达到极限以及代码评审和可靠性保障的根本性重新思考。

mainPoints.point: 语音与代理结合消除了思维到行动的转换步骤
mainPoints.explanation: 语音转文本工作流允许用户直接处理客户电话或半成熟的想法，无需先进行书面记录，每日分享了 14 个具体的团队工作流程示例。

mainPoints.point: 实验室正在从昂贵的通用型模型转向混合模型结构
mainPoints.explanation: Every 工程师将 Anthropic 的模型阵列描述为组织架构：Fable 担任 CEO，Opus 5 担任高级工程师，Sonnet 5 担任初级工程师，专用模型在统一框架内协作而非依赖单一巨型模型。

mainPoints.point: 旧模型的指令可能暗中损害新模型的性能
mainPoints.explanation: "技能审计"工作流帮助确定遗留的提示和指令是否降低了当前模型的性能，这是模型快速迭代的实际问题。

keyQuotes: 配合代理，语音可以消除中间的转换步骤，因此你可以直接处理客户电话或半成熟的想法，无需先进行书面记录。
我们的工程师开始将 Anthropic 的模型描述为公司组织架构：Fable 担任 CEO，Opus 5 担任高级工程师，Sonnet 5 担任初级工程师。
